_comment: Refs the GHCR retention sweep (scripts/retention.py) must never delete, on top of what images.json and the keep-last-N rule protect. images.json now lists only the fresh hal0-runner-<key> images, so the packages that hal0 boxes installed before the fresh runner set (hal0-combined, hal0-toolbox-*, hal0-comfyui, hal0-strix-vulkan, hal0-promptforge, hal0-rocmfpx) are protected here instead. Keep every entry until the hal0 release that migrates boxes to the fresh images is the oldest supported release AND the operator has deleted the old package; then remove its lines in the same change. retention.py also unions hal0's machine-readable pin export at run start and aborts on any fetch or parse failure.
_comment_hal0_code_pins: Images released hal0 versions pin and installed boxes still pull, in tag AND digest form so a re-pushed tag cannot orphan the pinned digest. Sources: hal0 src/hal0/config/schema.py (DEFAULT_ROCMFPX_IMAGE, DEFAULT_STRIX_IMAGE, DEFAULT_PROMPTFORGE_IMAGE), hal0 manifest.json toolbox_images, per-slot image_pin values (hal0-combined-upstream:0829), and host profiles ([profile.hy3-fpx] -> hal0-rocmfpx).

evidence._comment: Gate evidence: the runners/upstream b11510 image that passed the PR #14 hardware gate, kept as the baseline the first runners/standard gate is compared against. Remove once a hal0-runner-standard digest is gated and pinned.
